name: findback
description: FindBack — minimal lost & found reporting/recovery Android app (course project).

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w services/api && npm run build -w apps/mobile
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w services/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/mobile
scripts.test: npm run test -w services/api && npm run test -w apps/mobile
scripts.apk: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/mobile && npm run apk -w apps/mobile
